graph.search: exhaustive float64 pairwise cosine; numpy lexsort
graph.normalization: L2 in float64 only; no PCA or feature scaling
graph.symmetrization: union: retain edge if either endpoint chooses the other
graph.ties: exact distance ties then lexicographic stable sample ID
graph.duplicates: retain every biological locus; exact duplicate vector pairs assigned cosine=1 and distance=0; collapse only in separate sensitivity
